name: Railway Sleeper Hostel
stayType: Hostel in a converted railway station
accommodation: 30 beds: dorm rooms with bunks plus private rooms
suitableFor: Families, students, groups and budget travellers
beachAccess: About 350 m to Castlerock beach; Downhill Strand about 1.4 miles
confirmedFeatures: Kitchen, lockers, guest lounge, TV and games room, laundry service, free linen and towels, WiFi
overview: A 30-bed hostel in Castlerock's original 1853 railway station on Sea Road, with dorms and private rooms, secure lockers and a shared kitchen and lounge. Free linen, towels and WiFi are included, and a laundry service is available. Castlerock beach is about 350 metres away and Downhill Strand under a mile and a half. The listing says it opens seasonally from March to October.
surfTripFit: A short walk from Castlerock beach and next to the trains, it is a cheap base for car-free surfers covering Castlerock and Downhill.
